abstract: OBJECTIVE: The objective of the study was to evaluate the clinical characteristics of ovarian teratoma by age. STUDY DESIGN: This was a retrospective study. Five hundred eighty medical records were reviewed from patients who underwent operative removal of ovarian teratomas at Samsung Medical Center between January 1996 and February 2010. RESULTS: The proportion of asymptomatic patients increased significantly after 20 years of age (P = .0006). Ovarian torsion was noted in 26 patients (4.9%), without an age-specific difference (P = .5019; range, 0.0-8.2%). Tumor size was different according to age group (P < .0001), with larger tumor size in younger patients (<20 years old) relative to older patients. Immature teratoma revealed a higher incidence of symptomatic tumors on the first visit and significantly larger tumor size (P = .0004) compared with mature teratoma. CONCLUSION: Patients with ovarian teratoma have different clinical manifestations by age. It could help us understand clinical characteristics of the disease.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣奇形腫の臨床的特徴を年齢別に評価すること。研究デザイン：後方視的研究。1996年1月から2010年2月の間にSamsung Medical Centerで卵巣奇形腫の摘出術を受けた患者580例の診療記録をレビューした。結果：20歳以上では無症状の割合が有意に増加した（P=.0006）。卵巣捻転は26例（4.9%）に認められ、年齢による差はなかった（P=.5019；範囲0.0-8.2%）。腫瘍径は年齢群で異なり（P<.0001）、20歳未満で大きかった。未熟奇形腫は成熟奇形腫と比べて初診時に有症状となる割合が高く、腫瘍径も有意に大きかった（P=.0004）。結論：卵巣奇形腫の臨床像は年齢によって異なる。この知見は本疾患の臨床的特徴の理解に役立つ。
